balls.text: he's hit a four! Tiwary was looking to hit the full toss straight down the ground but he got an outside edge that flew between backward point and short third man for four

Dilshan's gone! Dhawan tries to swing the ball over the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad, the ball drops on the pitch but Dilshan tries to steal a leg bye with Gilchrist standing up to the stumps, Dilshan's quick but not that quick, Gilchrist moves forward and breaks the stumps with a backhand throw with Dilshan well short
Dilshan tries to sweep from outside off again, trying to get the ball past short fine leg, this time he gets a bottom edge on the off side
a low full toss outside off stump, Dilshan moves across his stumps and paddles the ball over short fine leg for four, premeditated and extremely well executed

Dhawan is almost run out! He pull the ball over short fine leg and a fantastic dive to the long-leg boundary saves another boundary, the throw comes into the bowlers end and RP breaks the stumps with Dhawan just home

fantastic shot, the length is nearly in the block hole but Dhawan waits in his crease and drives the ball hard and straight, Sharma dives full length after running to his right from long-off and saves two runs
Vijaykumar ends the over with a fuller ball, Dilshan moves forward but is unable to get it away
smashed! Dilshan moves deep in his crease, waits for a full toss and pulls the ball powerfully over deep backward square leg, he was so deep in his crease that the length became a gift
Dhawan drives a full ball outside off stump towards deep cover for only a single
bowled full in the blockhole, Dilshan backs away towards leg but Vijaykumar follows him, he manages to work the ball behind  square on the leg side
fuller length outside off stump, driven hard off the front foot towards cover where RP makes a sharp stop, he's trying to hit it too hard and has lost his timing
full toss outside off stump, Dhawan tries to smash it, a bit too hard perhaps, and he misses completely
good length delivery but Dilshan moves back in a flash and cuts the ball hard through covers for four, what a shot to play off your first ball
Dhawan comes forward and mis-times the drive back past the bowler

caught! Sharma takes it this time, Maharoof tries to clear the straight boundary once again, this time the ball was too far away from him and he slices it high in the air and Sharma takes a simple catch at point, Sharma's earlier drop has cost Deccan 18 runs
Dhawan fails to make proper contact as he tries to nudge the ball on the leg side and runs a leg bye
driven hard down the ground to long off for a single
that is colossal! Maharoof comes out of his crease and makes room as well, he uses his long arms and swings his bat powerfully to send the ball sailing over deep midwicket, watch out in the crowd
this time he mis-times it past the bowler for a single to retain strike
that is just too short and there's width for Maharoof as well, he comes forward and swings his bat hard to slam the ball over the straight boundary, poor death bowling
sliced towards deep point where Gibbs runs to his left and slides to save the boundary

Maharoof moves his front foot out of the way and tries to tee off against a short of a length ball, he is looking to hit down the ground but misses, Gilchrist whips off the bails but Maharoof's back foot was just inside, close call

dropped! And would you believe it by Sharma, Maharoof flat bats a shorter ball straight down the ground, Sharma runs to his left from long off and gets to the ball a little too quickly, he gets cramped for room while taking the catch and spills it, the ball nearly runs over the boundary but Sharma recovers and pulls it back it
Dhawan moves on to the back foot and forces a full ball through square leg
once again he is squared up by a flat ball that turns a bit away from the right-hander, he gets another outside edge towards backward point
Maharoof gets squared up on the back foot and gets an outside edge towards short third man
Dhawan charges and tries to force the ball on the leg side, he misses and gets hit on the pad
Ojha pitches on leg stump, Dhawan plants his front foot forward, gets down on one knee and sweeps firmly past the fielder at short fine leg for four more
Maharoof tries to cut but gets a bottom edge past Gilchrist

stumped! Gambhir steps out of his crease and maybe a bit too early for Ojha fires the ball down leg side, Gambhir can't reach the ball and he lets it go through to Gilchrist who whips off the bails with Gambhir well short
pulled off the back foot to deep backward square leg
another full toss wide outside off stump, Gambhir tries to take advantage of the fielder in the circle at third man but can't connect with the reverse sweep
driven off the front foot through point for a single
full toss outside off stump, Gambhir plays the reverse sweep towards short third man where a mis-field allows more runs, Sarvesh was the fielder
fuller length outside off, Dhawan reaches out for it and drives through point for one more
a full toss out side off stump, Gambhir comes forward and hits it with a flat bat towards long off
bowled full and wide outside off stump, Gambhir lets it go but the umpire doesn't
fullish length outside off stump, Dhawan plants his front foot forward and drives to long-on
swept powerfully towards long leg for  a single

Dhawan also reaches his fifty, he makes room and drives the ball hard and into the gap at extra cover, four more and Deccan are losing it here, just like they did against Kolkata during the final overs
what power! Dhawan gives Afridi a taste of his own but clobbering the ball with a flat bat over Afridi's head, that shot to the boudnary
driven firmly off the front foot towards wide long-on for  a single
Gambhir charges Afridi and hoists him high and far with the turn over deep midwicket, stunning hit
Gambhir moves back to a quicker ball and chips it past the bowler, they run one and then Dhawan sprints back to the danger end for the second
Gambhir moves on to the front foot and nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket for one more
fuller ball angling into off and middle stump, Dhawan drives off the front foot towards long-off
short and wide outside off once again, this time Gambhir cuts off the back foot in front of point for  a single
short and wide outside off stump, not the cleverest line when third man is in the circle, Gambhir waits for it and cuts between short third man and backward point for four more
cheeky but oh so effective, Gambhir moves across his stumps on the front foot and paddles the ball fine towards the fine leg boundary, he cashed in on Sarvesh's leg-stump line
driven off the front foot through cover for two more
Gambhir charges once again and drives the ball hard towards long-on, they are racing along now, setting up the platform for an assault towards the final overs
Gambhir moves forward and across and flicks off his pads wide of the fielder at short fine leg
bowled full and on leg stump, Dhawan tries to flick but gets only a bit of bat on to it for a single towards short fine leg
Dhawan pulls the reverse sweep out of the bag and places it past the fielder at short third man, four more
he gets to fifty by driving the ball off the front foot through cover, he's continuing his terrific form
Gambhir steps out of his crease, makes room, and drives powerfully towards wide long-off where Sarvesh dives but can't prevent the boundary
fantastic placement! Dhawan gets down on one knee and smacks a good length ball from Styris over midwicket, he's split the gap in the deep with slog sweep perfectly
full length outside off,Dhawan moves forward and drives powerfully towards the fielder on the point boundary
Dhawan tries to slog across the line but gets an inside edge on to his pad
full and wide outside off stump, Gambhir tries to cut and gets an edge that falls just short of Venugopal at short third man, he mis-fields to allow the single
Dhawan nearly loses balance as he sweeps one from outside off through square leg
Dhawan charges Styris who drags his length short outside off stump, Dhawan lofts the ball over cover and it falls safely in the deep
Dhawan steps out of his crease and drives towards long on for a single
now he gets down on one knee and sweeps past the fielder at short fine leg

Dhawan uses his feet to come out and reach the pitch of the ball, once he's there Dhawan drives the ball firmly between midwicket and mid-on, he's placed it well enough to beat the fielder in the deep
Venugopal fires the ball down leg side from round the wicket, wide called
Gambhir moves back in his crease and makes room to cut the ball from his stumps towards point
driven off the front foot through cover point for a single
Gambhir tries to blast the ball over cover off the front foot but gets beaten
Gambhir waits on the back foot and opens the face at the last moment and guides the ball to short third man, he was initially looking to play the paddle sweep

mid-on's in the circle and Gambhir's gone over him, the length is full on off stump, Gambhir clears his front foot out of the way and lofts the ball flat over mid-on, the ball bounces once before going over the rope
Dhawan moves back and cuts a good length ball hard towards cover, the fielder throws at the bowler's end and concedes an overthrow
Gambhir takes a stride forward and drives a fuller ball firmly towards long-off
width offered outside off stump, Dhawan waits on the back foot and cuts the ball towards third man
Dhawan moves on to the front foot and flicks the ball through square leg
flicked off the pads towards long leg for a single, they didn't sprint, just strolled through
Gambhir leans forward to a good length delivery and tries to drive, he gets an outside edge to short third man, he'll be a bit ginger after that blow to his knee

Gambhir moves his front foot out of the way to make room and tries to slog a good length ball through midwicket, he gets an inside edge which strikes him on the knee cap, he's in a lot of pain and is on the floor
risky shot, Gambhir makes room by moving towards leg and cuts the ball from off stump towards short third man, Gambhir wanted the run but was sent back, direct hit would have been close
good length delivery on leg and middle stump, Dhawan moves deep in his crease and nudges the ball off his pads behind square
Dhawan plants his front foot forward and across his stumps and swats a good length ball from outside off towards deep midwicket, he keeps the strike
Dhawan tries to cut off the back foot but is cramped for room by Styris, the ball beats the bat once again
tight line and length on middle and off stump, Gambhir opens the face and plays the ball towards backward point
Dhawan tries to flick a good length ball off his pads but doesn't make proper contact, they scamper a single towards the leg side
fuller length outside off stump, Dhawan moves on to the front foot, waits for the ball and plays the square drive late to place it in the gap on the backward point boundary, well struck!
driven off the front foot towards deep point for  a single
good length but the line is wide outside off, Dhawan tries to cut off the back foot but is beaten
that's short from Sarvesh and Gambhir tries to pull off the front foot, he misses and gets hit on the pad for a leg bye on the on side
this time Sarvesh strays down leg side and he'll have to re-bowl that one
good length ball angles across the left-hander, Gambhir stays in his crease and tries to run the ball to third man but gets beaten

Gambhir charges the bowler for the umpteenth time, Sarvesh bowls it full and wide outside off, Gambhir throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies wide of Gilchrist for four to third man
fuller ball on off stump, Dhawan strides forward and drives towards point where Afridi mis-fields and allows the single, Gambhir gets the strike back
Gambhir stays on the back foot and opens the face to guide the ball towards third man

fantastic effort! Gambhir charges Vijaykumar and tries to loft a good length ball over the cover boundary, he mis-hits it and the ball lobs high in the air over cover, Sharma runs back and dives desperately but manages to get only finger tips to it even though he is at full length
Dhawan moves out of his crease and works a good length ball behind square for one more
driven off the back foot towards the off side

Gambhir charges Vijaykumar but nearly yorks himself after the bowler fires one in full and fast, he gets an inside edge on to the pad, he calls for a quick single and Dhawan and Vijaykumar scramble together, one wants to make his ground the other wants to reach the ball and effect a run out
Dhawan moves forward to a good length ball and pushes it towards mid-off for a quick single
Vijaykumar pitches the ball on a good length around off stump and straightens it into the left-hander, Dhawan defends back to the bowler
the length is a fraction short and Dhawan moves back and across to pull the ball through square leg, he hasn't timed it well
a good length delivery angles into the left-hander, Gambhir tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad, they run a leg bye
Gambhir charges once again, RP bowls it short and wide outside off, Gambhir throws his bat at it and cuts the ball hard through point for four
he's done it again! Gambhir steps out of his crease this time, RP responds with a short ball and Gambhir once again pulls the ball hard and flat over midwicket
terrific hit! RP pitches the ball short, Gambhir comes on to the front foot and plays a ferocious pull over deep square leg, that has gone several rows back
short of a length on middle stump, nudged off the hips towards long leg for  a single
that's full and wide outside off stump, the ball seams away from Dhawan who chases it and attempts to play the square drive, he misses and the umpire calls it wide
Gambhir moves forward and mis-times the on-drive towards mid-on, excellent over, only two runs off it, Deccan have made a terrific start
better length from Vijaykumar with a hint of movement into the left-hander, Gambhir gets behind the line and defends on the back foot
that's short and a bit wide outside off stump, Dhawan moves back and across and cuts the ball towards third man for  a single
Dhawan moves on to the front foot and clicks a good length delivery towards square leg
Gambhir comes down the track and hits the ball towards deep backward square leg, that was more of an inside edge
Gambhir moves on to the back foot and opens the face of the bat to run a short of a length delivery towards point, Gibbs once again dives to his right to make a sharp save
short of a length outside off stump, Dhawan waits on the back foot and lets it go

edged but the ball fell short of the slips! Dhawan pushed forward to defend a good length ball that straightened off the pitch and the outside edge fell short and threaded the gap between first and second slip
short of a length delivery angles into the left-hander, Dhawan gets behind the line on the back foot and defends
there's an appeal for a run-out now! Dhawan drives a full ball towards point where Afridi picks up and hits the stumps at the bowler's end, Gambhir was out of his crease but just managed to get back

shot! And splendid fielding! the length is too full outside off stump, Gambhir moves forward and hits the cover drive with immense power towards cover where Sharma dives to his left and stops the ball
good length to start with outside off, Gambhir lets it go through to Gilchrist

caught! Sehwag goes! The length was short and the line was wide outside off, Sehwag does what he always does to such deliveries, he slashes hard but the ball flies fast and flat towards third man where RP takes a comfortable catch, he didn't get the elevation he wanted
a good length ball pitches outside off and seams away from the right-hander, Sehwag moves forward and drives on the up towards point with an open face, Gibbs slides to his right and fields at point
too straight once again on middle and leg, Gambhir moves back and flicks the ball towards long leg for a single
this time Gambhir walks forward and glances the ball off his pads towards the fine leg boundary, he timed that superbly but the line was poor from Vijaykumar
short of a length but the line is down leg side, Gambhir tries to play the leg glance but gets hit on the thigh, Gilchrist dives to his right to collect
Gambhir moves forward to change the length to a fuller one and closes the face of the bat to guide the ball through midwicket, he's got going with two
that's it, Delhi have held on to win a thriller, Vijaykumar pulls the last ball towards deep midwicket for only a single
Sarvesh pulls the ball on to his pad for a single
he could have had four in four! Sarvesh charges and misses but Karthik fails to collect the ball, imagine that he could have had four wickets in a row

he's got the hat-trick! RP charges down the track and swings wildly, Mishra bowls the flatter, faster and straighter ball, RP misses and Karthik breaks the stumps with the batsman well short, Mishra loves sit, he's a hero , the Kotla cheers itself hoarse

caught again! Mishra's got his fourth, Ojha charges down the pitch and tries to heave down the ground, Mishra slips in the goodly and Ojha slices the ball high in the air towards cover where Dilshan takes a simple catch

he's cleared the boundary! No he hasn't, Malik's taken the catch at long off! Mishra bowled the flatter and faster ball outside off stump, Teja made room and hit it with a flat bat towards long off where Malik moved to his left and held on to a hard catch
full and straight from McGrath, Teja drives towards long off for the single
that's cleared the boundary! Teja made room by backing away towards the leg side, got down on one knee and sliced the low full toss over the backward point boudnary, terrific shot
full ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot towards the off side for a single
full and in the blockhole, Teja digs it out on the leg side for a single

caught! Rao's gone and have Deccan's hopes gone with him? McGrath bowled a fuller length and angled it into the right-hander, Rao got under it and lofted the ball high in the air, it's gone miles in the air but doesn't have enough distance to clear the boudnary, Shoaib Malik settles under the catch at long on and takes it comfortably
Teja moves back and guides the ball towards third man to give Rao the strike, sensible batting
Rao you beauty! He's swung the last ball of the over superbly over deep midwicket, the ball was a bit too full and Rao got nicely under it, 18 runs off the over
he's got a four now! Rao backs away once again, Maharoof bowls the slower ball but the length is a bit short, Rao smashes the ball over extra cover for a one bounce four
Rao's hammered it on to the second tier! He backed away to a slower ball, swung his bat hard and hit the ball straight over the bowler's head for a massive six, Deccan need a few more like that

caught! Nothing gets past de Villiers! Styris backs away to make room and lofts a short of a length ball off the front foot, he's hit it high in the air towards long-on, de Villiers runs in at pace and times his slide perfectly and holds on to a well-judged catch
Rao backs away towards leg and Maharoof follows him, he tries to hit the ball past the fielder at short fine leg but can't do it
the slower ball on a good length on middle stump, Styris waits in his crease and pulls the ball towards deep backward square leg
Rao cuts the ball between backward point and short third man for the third boundary of the over, they've got the runs they needed off this over, can they maintain the tempo?
driven towards long off this time for a single
he's hit another one! Although it was a mis-field that allowed the four, Styris drove it hard and straight but Tiwary fumbled at long on
a full toss outside off stump and Styris finally hits a boundary, he gives himself room and drives the ball through extra cover for four
Rao moves across his stumps and tries to play the paddle past short fine leg but doesn't make proper contact
driven firmly off the front foot towards long off for just the single
a low full toss and Styris drives the ball towards long off where Dilshan runs to his right and makes a sliding save
he backs away once again and Maharoof bowls it a little shorter, Rao cuts through point for a single
Rao backs away towards the leg side to make room and cuts the full and low ball between backward point and short third man for four
full toss and Styris frees his arms and pulls the ball towards deep midwicket where Sehwag fields
excellent bowling, slow and in the blockhole, Rao drives towards long on for a single
the slower ball bowled full outside off stump, Styris comes forward and drives to long off, admirable shot but Deccan need much more, he hasn't hit a boundary yet
driven firmly off the front foot towards de Villiers at cover
Styris backs away and drives a full toss much squarer on the off side, Dhawan dives on the backward point boudnary and saves two runs
another full toss outside off stump, Rao drives once again towards deep point for one
a low full toss outside off stump, Styris drives to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
Rao drives a good length ball off the front foot towards deep point
full ball in the blockhole on middle stump, driven off the front foot towards long on for just two
Bhatia sends one down on off stump at the fiery pace of 100 kmh, Rao can't do much about it but cut straight to the fielder at point, absolutely no pace on the ball
Bhatia bowls another slow offcutter on off and middle stump, Rao comes on to the front foot and defends to point
another slower ball outside off, Styris pushes on the off side and takes a single towards cover point
the slower ball but the length is too short outside off, Styris moves back and drives past de Villiers at cover for two more
Bhatia is keeping it full on the stumps, driven off the front foot towards the off side
full length on middle stump, Styris moves forward and drives towards long on for  a single
a slow full toss outside off stump, Rao drives towards cover where de Villiers fields once again
Rao pushes the ball off the back foot towards backward point and wants the single, Styris sends him back and there's a bit of a mix-up

bowled him! That is that for Sharma, he moves across his stumps, exposing all three to Maharoof , and tries to play the paddle sweep past short fine leg, the length is good and once Sharma misses the ball crashes into middle stump, he's been in excellent form but that shot was fraught with risk and Sharma paid for it
full ball on off stump, driven off the front foot towards long off

Styris pushes a short of a length ball towards cover and sets off for the single, Sharma sends him back but Styris is a long way down, de Villiers fields at cover and fires the throw into Karthik who collects and demolishes all three stumps, Styris runs back and puts in a full length drive, it's extremely close, very very close and the third umpire rules in favour of the batsman, his bat was just, only just inside the crease, was it in the air though? Too close to give
a full toss on off stump, Sharma makes room by moving towards leg and drives towards long off
pushed off the back foot towards point, no run and Sharma will have the strike

Sharma leans forward and pushes a slower ball off his pads towards midwicket, they run the single but Sharma wants the strike back, Styris sends him back and Shram just makes his crease before the bowler breaks the stumps
make that 18! Sharma steps forward and lofts Bhatia cleanly right back over his head, that is as straight as you can hit it
massive six! Sharma waits in his crease for a short of a length ball and pulls it powerfully over deep square leg, they've already taken 14 off this over
short and wide outside off stump, Sharma cuts hard to the deep where Tiwary makes an excellent save on the point boundary
that is huge! Sharma uses his feet to step out to Bhatia and swings the low full toss far over long-on, super shot!
Sharma backs away towards leg, Mishra cramps him for room by following him, Sharma flicks through square leg for  a single
a bot too short from Mishra, Styris moves back and nudges the ball through midwicket for one
Sharma comes out of his crease, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives towards long on
Styris leans forward and clips a full toss through midwicket for just the single
driven down the ground to long off for one
Sharma stands in his crease and drives the ball inside out with the turn over extra cover, lovely shot
Styris moves across his stumps and tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads, Karthik appeals from behind the stumps but Styris was too far forward
he moves forward this time and drives the ball through midwicket for  a single
well played! the length was full outside off stump, Sharma made room by moving towards leg and squeezed the ball past the fielder at short third man for four
slower ball at 103 kmh on middle and leg, Styris moves across and works the ball off his pads behind square
tight line and length on off stump, Styris waits in his crease and defends towards point
Styris moves on to the front foot and nudges the ball towards midwicket
fired into middle stump, Styris moves forward and drives towards deep midwicket, only four runs and a wicket off the over
bowled quicker and flatter on off stump, Styris moves forward and pushes towards cover point
Styris moves on to the front foot and drives towards cover
he gets off the mark by working the ball off his pads towards midwicket

he's bowled him! Gibbs charges down the track and tries to smash Mishra over cover, the ball beats Gibbs in the flight and it is the googly which spins in to the right-hander and uproots middle stump after Gibbs fails to connect with his wild swing
driven off the front foot straight past the bowler for a single
Gibbs tries to hit across the line once again and gets beaten, he's playing his shot way too early
full and straight from Bhatia, Gibbs moves forward and drives firmly but straight back to the bowler
Gibbs gets down on one knee and tries to slog across the line but gets beaten
Sharma moves back and cuts the ball from outside off stump towards third man
Sharma moves forward and defends once again towards cover, tight line from Bhatia
good length ball on off stump, defended on the front foot on the off side
he gets a leading edge on the off side as he tries to close the face and play it on the leg side
Gibbs smashes a long hop hard at cover where de villiers makes an excellent stop
bowled full outside off stump, Sharma moves back and drives towards long off for a single

caught! What a strike off his first ball! Afridi backs away to make room and tries to smash a flat ball over the off side, he loses grip of the bat handle and slices the ball in the air towards point, de Villiers runs backwards and takes a fine catch over his shoulder, Afridi was looking to hit straight down the ground but sliced it
a full ball on off stump, Afridi drives powerfully but can't beat  the fielder at mid-off
that has gone miles! Afridi backs away towards the leg side to make room, Maharoof bowls it short of a length outside off stump, Afridi frees his arms and carts the ball over the cover boundary
the slower ball bowled full on middle stump, Gibbs drives towards long on for the single
tight line and length on middle stump, Afridi moves back and nudges the ball towards square leg for one, three balls remain in the Powerplays
short of a length delivery outside off, Afridi opens the face and runs the ball towards short fine leg, he can't get it past the fielder
fuller length on middle and leg, the pace is slower from Maharoof and Gibbs works the ball off his pads behind square

simply amazing! Afridi moves very early towards the leg side to make room, McGrath sees him going and bowls the slower ball on the stumps, Afridi waits for it, reaches out, and slashes, the ball hits the outside edge and flies over point, it's not timed well but the ball still rolls to the boundary
McGrath is looking for the block hole again but Gibbs leans across and drives the ball wide of the fielder at mid-on for a single
McGrath fires the ball into the block hole, Gibbs digs it out
take that! Gibbs moves across his stumps, gets down low, and pulls a short of a length delivery flat but far over the deep backward square leg boundary, audacious shot
defended on the front foot towards the off side
amazing shot! The ball is poor, full and wide outside off stump, Gibbs moves on to the front foot, gets under the ball and lofts it cleanly over the extra cover boundary, consecutive sixes for Deccan
Afridi's clobbered Asif, the length is too short and Afridi gets into position and pulls the ball powerfully off the front foot over deep midwicket, that is several rows back
too straight once again and Gibbs flicks off his pads towards long leg for a single
he's cracked that! Gibbs stays on the back foot, waits for the short of a length delivery and blasts it over cover with a straight bat, terrific shot
Asif strays down leg side this time, Gibbs moves across his stumps and lets it go, that's a wide
what's he trying? Gibbs moves across his stumps, gets down on one knee and tries to sweep a good length ball from outside off stump, needless to say he gets beaten
short of a length on middle stump, Afridi pushes the ball with soft hands towards midwicket and hurtles through for the single
Afridi moves forward, picks up the length and lofts Asif cleanly through the line, he places the ball straight back over the bowler's head and gets four
good lengths delivery outside off stump, Gibbs lets it go again

McGrath pitches the slower ball just short of a length and angles it into Afridi, he nudges the ball towards midwicket and runs the quick single, the fielder at midwicket throws at the bowler's end even through Afridi is safe and concedes four overthrows, McGrath looks grumpy about that
a bit too straight from McGrath this time on middle and leg, there's no fine leg and Gibbs flicks the ball off his pads towards deep backward square leg
McGrath seams the ball into the right-hander from outside off stump, Gibbs strides forward and blocks
good length delivery in the channel outside off stump, left alone by Gibbs

caught! and it's an exceptional catch! Gilchrist moved forward to a good length ball and smashed it, absolutely smashed it, towards mid-off, the ball flew flat and low towards Dilshan who moved forward and dived to take a low catch, fantastic effort and the Delhi Daredevils mob him

another outside edge and it's dropped, Gilchrist moves across and tries to work a good length ball on the leg side, Asif seams the ball across the left-hander and the outside edge flies between the keeper and first slip, Karthik dives to his left and gets a glove to it but can't hold on
good length delivery angles across the left-hander outside off stump, Gilchrist moves back and shoulders arms
this time Gilchrist fends off the front foot and gets beaten, Asif pitched it just short of a length and seamed it away

this time the good length has Gilchrist in two minds, whether to come forward or move back, in the end he plays from his crease and the seam movement across him takes the outside edge, the ball flies wide of first slip for four
short and wide outside off stump, that's disappeared to the point boudnary, Gilchrist rocked on to the back foot and cut the ball hard through point, awesome power
wide outside off stump this time, Gilchrist lets it go, first extra of the innings

dropped? Or did it not carry? Afridi tries to hit a fuller ball across the line and hits the ball with the bottom of the bat, it flies in the air towards midwicket but falls just short of Dhawan who dives forward
